user.title: Add a stop or a place
user.description: Add one stop, or a place: several stops near one spot (for example your home) shown together on one card and one map.

menu_options.stop: One stop, chosen from the list
menu_options.place: A place with several nearby stops

stop.title: Choose a stop
stop.description: Pick the stop from the list. The list is built into the integration; when your Home Assistant is in Košice, the nearest stops come first.

data.stop_number: Stop number (only if your stop is missing from the list)

data_description.stop_number: The number in the address dpmk.sk/cp/zastavka/<number>. It overrides the list.

place.title: Add a place
place.description: Name the place and put it on the map. All DPMK stops within the radius can then be added.

data.location: Location and radius for finding stops

place_stops.title: Stops of the place
place_stops.description: {count} stops found around the spot; the {inside} within your {radius} m radius are ticked. Tick more or fewer as you like: the others are just outside the radius, with their distance.

error.unknown_stop: dpmk.sk does not know a stop with this number
error.no_stops_nearby: No DPMK stop within this radius: move the pin or make the radius larger

data.auto_location: Put the map where the stop is
data.is_default: Use as the default for cards

data_description.update_interval: How often the live vehicle feed is read. Minimum 5 s. DPMK itself updates a vehicle roughly every 20 s, so values below 10 s rarely help.
data_description.language: Used by both cards unless a card sets its own language. Automatic follows the Home Assistant language (Slovak or English).
data_description.stop_ids: The stops within 1 km of the place, plus the ones you chose.
data_description.auto_location: A single stop only. Turn off to place the map on a point of your own (the next field).
data_description.location: Used for a place, and for a stop when the option above is off.
data_description.map_radius: How far around the centre vehicles are shown.
data_description.is_default: Cards without an entity use this stop or place.
